text: As I walk through these halls and conference spaces, I sense the electric drive of collective purpose—a blend of curiosity, focus, and collaboration. The glass walls symbolize the transparency and permeability of ideas, while the bright, graphic displays provoke my mind to consider the boundaries between research and creativity. I feel inspired, slightly disoriented by the tilt of the world, eager to engage yet aware of my outsider’s perspective among these thoughtful, innovative endeavors.
